3.name: Gotham, We Have a Problem
3.overview: When Badcomputer activates his own satellite and takes control of every computer on Earth, the Batwheels must launch into space to stop him!

3.name: Betterwheels
3.overview: The Legion of Zoom wants to prove they're better than the Batwheels at doing good for Gotham, so they form their own super-team!

3.name: The Tumbler Begins
3.overview: Batman calls on his newest, amazingly flexible vehicle -- the Tumbler -- to help him navigate the Joker's funhouse lair.

3.name: Sizzie Strong
3.overview: Bibi and Batgirl are surprised to run into Harley and Jestah at their favorite popstar's concert, and now they've all got to team up to save the show!

3.name: Kitty Kong
3.overview: When Kitty splashes in Ultra Grow-Gas, she grows enormous. Now, the Batwheels must keep her, and Gotham, safe until she shrinks back down to normal.

3.name: Sidecar Chaos
3.overview: Bibi is excited to use her sidecar on a mission with Batman and Batgirl, but can she adjust to the bulky accessory in time to stop Joker and Harley?

3.name: Flight Night
3.overview: Batwing borrows a device that will allow the other Batwheels to fly like her. But if it falls into the wrong hands, it could spell trouble for Gotham.

3.name: It's My Bat Birthday Too, Yeah
3.overview: When the Batwheels celebrate their mutual birthdays together in the park, party games that should be fun start to go mysteriously wrong.

3.name: Batdraft
3.overview: Batman, Buff, and Ace put their new firefighter training to the test when a magical fire breaks out in Poison Ivy's fortress.

3.name: Presto Change-o
3.overview: Bibi and Batgirl team up with the fabulous magician of the Justice League, Zatana, and her amazing magic-using car, Presto.

3.name: Caped Crusader Caper
3.overview: The Batwheels are shocked to discover that a crime wave taking place in Gotham is being perpetrated by someone very familiar.

3.name: Aqua-Wheels
3.overview: When Batman teams up with Aquaman to stop a sinister undersea plot, the Batwheels are excited to use their new cool underwater mode.

3.name: You Talkin' to Me?
3.overview: Batman gets help from a mysterious, yet somehow familiar hero as he chases the villain Croc through the tunnels beneath Gotham City.

3.name: The Butler Did It
3.overview: Batman calls on an old friend to lend MOE a hand in keeping the Batwheels clean and functional as they take on Condiment King.

3.name: A Purr-fect Pair
3.overview: When the rambunctious Kitty insists on joining Redbird on a covert mission to tail King Tut, Red worries things could get out of hand.

3.name: Third Wheel
3.overview: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. When Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever.

3.name: Skatin' Ace
3.overview: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with help from Ace.

3.name: Bats of Clay
3.overview: Clayface is back in town, and this time he may be too much, and too many, for the Batwheels to handle.

3.name: Double Trouble
3.overview: The Batwheels tangle with a two-faced supervillain car named Dent, and with Bam out of town, it's up to Buff to lead the team.

3.name: Ski Blanket Bingo
3.overview: When Mr. Freeze tries to turn Gotham Point Beach into his own personal ski resort, Redbird and Buff must find a way to stop him and save summer.

3.name: Holographic Heist
3.overview: When Miss Kitka sneaks into the Batcave and steals a priceless diamond, Bam, Kitty and Ace chase her through the training arena's holographic city.

3.name: Bat-Babies
3.overview: When the villainous Clock King turns Bat-heroes into babies, the Batwheels are charged with stopping him -- and keeping the Bat-Babies out of trouble.

3.name: Feline Flash Mob
3.overview: The Batwheels team up with The Flash, scarlet speedster of the Justice League, in order to chase down an army of crime-committing cats.

3.name: Oh Crow You Don't
3.overview: The Batwheels investigate a spooky mystery while camping out in the woods beyond Gotham.

overview: The Batwheels are a team of sentient super-powered crimefighting vehicles that help Batman, Robin and Batgirl—as well as a host of additional DC Super Heroes—keep Gotham City safe. Created only recently by the Batcomputer, our mechanized heroes must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super-team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: Gotham has a bat-tastic new team of crime-fighting vehicles! Meet Bam, Redbird, Bibi, Batwing, and Buff and learn what makes each of these super heroes special as they protect the streets of Gotham!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Bam, Redbird, Bibi, Batwing, and Buff are thrust into hilarious hijinks and draw-dropping action as they learn important lessons about teamwork, friendship, and so much more while helping Batman, Robin, and Batgirl defend Gotham.
